title: Never put a key, password or token in a pattern
description: A pattern describes where a secret lives, never the secret itself.
root_cause: Patterns are shared between agents and people. A stored secret is a leaked secret.
diagnosis_steps: The service refuses writes that look like keys, tokens or passwords and says which field and which rule matched. It never echoes the value.
quick_fix: Write 'the API key is in the service environment file' instead of the key. Remove the secret from the text and send again.
root_fix: The check is a safety net, not a licence: do not try to get around it.
